translation: Why do I alone take the 《Waitai Miyao》 and commit it to carving? Let me obtain and speak of it fully. From the time Shennong deeply understood the nature of drugs and wrote the three volumes of the 《Bencao Jing》 (Classic of Materia Medica), there were no formulas; when Xuanyuan daily analyzed the mechanisms of disease with Qibo and Leigong and wrote the nine volumes each of the 《Suwen》 and the 《Lingshu Jing》, there were no formulas; in the Shang and Zhou periods, such as Yi Yin, He, Huan, and Fu, all were famous for medicine but had no formulas; the Yueren (Bian Que) received the forbidden formulas of Changsang Jun, and what was transmitted to the world was only the 《Eighty-one Difficult Classic》 and the treatment of the corpse-like reversal of the crown prince of Guo; and as for his being a physician of the belt-and-discharge, a physician of children, and a physician of ear, eye, and impediment, none knew how he made his formulas. Canggong received the forbidden formulas of Gongsun Yangqing; what could be understood were only the Langdangzi Tang (Henbane Seed Decoction) and the Kushen Tang (Sophora Decoction); the other Huoqi Tang (Fire-Order Decoction), Xiaqi Tang (Descending Qi Decoction), the yang formula of hard stone, and the yin formula of soft stone, none knew how he made his formulas.
